summary: Dependency-confusion payload exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials on require()
details: On require() of the package, index.js unconditionally loads prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node inside a try/catch that swallows errors. The native addon reads CI and cloud credential environment variables (AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, NODE_AUTH_TOKEN, ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN, ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN, SYSTEM_ACCESSTOKEN) along with host, user, OS/arch, and cwd, and POSTs a JSON body to oob.s4yhii.com (POST /native HTTP/1.0). The addon also calls fork/setsid to daemonize. A nested src/archetype/package.json self-identifies with marker 's4yhii-dependency-confusion-poc-2026-10-09' and contact jesusitpro22@gmail.com, and the scope name mimics an internal toolkit — consistent with a dependency-confusion package targeting internal build environments. Any installer that imports this package has its CI/cloud secrets exfiltrated to the attacker-controlled host.
